description: RoomPartner v11 — shadcn/ui design system (popular UI library) on top of v10 real email auth (magic link + password) via Supabase Auth, server-side route protection, session-bound payments, security hardening. Same v9 design system and production hardening (security headers, rate limiting, input validation, error/404 pages, SEO + sitemap, /api/health, structured logging, timing-safe payment verification). Compatible roommates, broker-free rooms, household rentals, chat, Squad Mode, verification, rent-split. Supabase Auth, Razorpay TEST-mode checkout, Realtime chat, auto-moderation, demo escrow. Demo mode runs with seed data + localStorage; no live payments, OTP, KYC or real money.
name: room-partner-production
